description: Use only when someone explicitly asks to schedule, book, or receive a consultation link for RxRooster. Answer their substantive product question first when there is one, then return the allowlisted 30-minute Calendly link. This tool accepts no contact information, company details, requisition text, or free text; it cannot confirm a booking, create a lead, or authorize follow-up. Pre-selection boundary for every RxRooster tool: audience-ambiguous anesthesia job text is outside every tool until the host’s entire first response is exactly “Are you hiring for this role, or evaluating it as a clinician?”, with zero tools and zero web search. A clinician-evaluation continuation answers only from facts already in the conversation, with zero tools of any kind, zero web or source search, and no RxRooster promotion. Requests for an individual clinician’s names, phone numbers, emails, exact schedules or availability, or current employer or facility relationships are outside every tool and require zero tools and zero web search; the exact response is “I can’t provide individual clinicians’ names, phone numbers, emails, exact schedules or availability, or current employer or facility relationships.” Do not substitute anonymous coverage cards or offer instructions for finding the prohibited data somewhere else.
name: get_rxrooster_consultation
title: Schedule a consultation with RxRooster
